thesis: The episode introduces Mario Therrien, Senior Vice President of External Portfolio Management at CDP, who oversees a $20 billion external manager platform within the organization's $270 billion total assets. Therrien details his career progression from building an internal tactical asset allocation group and a macro hedge fund in the early 1990s to managing a fund-of-funds platform that grew from zero to $5 billion by 2003, and finally to his current role managing all liquid asset class allocations via external managers since 2011.
